publisher: Office of the Secretary of State, State of Iowa
ownership: Official active business-entity public records published through the Iowa Data Hub
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS metadata, schema, and archive endpoints.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata, schema, and archive access
redistribution of approved normalized fields under CC BY 4.0 with attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing Active as independent proof of current operations, legality, solvency, public access, licensure, or an open storefront
representing a source-defined home office or its geocode as a verified current physical operating site
representing this state registry as every business operating in Iowa or the United States
exporting registered-agent names, addresses, or coordinates through normalized or national outputs
inferring an owner, employee, customer-facing location, or organization relationship from registered-agent or home-office data
merging registrations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Office of the Secretary of State, State of Iowa, Active Iowa Business Entities, via Iowa Data Hub, licensed CC BY 4.0.
retention: Indefinite for immutable internal source archives and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved business-only normalized fields may be redistributed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, field exclusions, and status/address limitations retained; the source archive remains internal because it contains registered-agent personal data.
personal_data_handling: Business names and home-office addresses may identify individuals or residences. The connector excludes registered-agent name, address, ZIP, geocode, and location fields; excludes the source home-office name; and prohibits treating the remaining address as a public storefront or operating site.
